title: automation and Omnipod Dash
body:
It is well known, that shortly after changing an omnipod DASH, many users faced a  significant increase in their blood sugar for a few hours. I thought of making an automation using the following:

Conditions : 
a) glucose is equal or higher than 95mgr
b) pod activated
c) cannula age is lesser than 4.0 hours

Preconditions : 
profile percentage is equal to 100
tem target not exist

ACTION : 
a) start profile 125% for 7minutes
b) start temporary target : 115mgr / 7 minutes

This automation seems that is not working. Can you please help me how to fix it ? 

Best regards from Greece
Antonis
